text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Focus more on twisting your body<n>from your hips!
Imagine you're<n>cutting through the air like this!
See?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I find Seeking the Pearl and<n>King Halo
swinging brooms through<n>the air.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We're doing some special training so<n>that King can
deal with a phobia of<n>hers with speed and ease!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Said phobia is apparently a spiderweb<n>stretching
across a window. King<n>Halo has been put in charge
of<n>cleaning, and is now trying to<n>approach the web
without letting it<n>enter her field of vision.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I may have run away from it before,<n>but now, after
having undergone<n>special training...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I will not falter! Hraaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo courageously stands<n>before the
spiderweb, however...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What was that just now?! Stay away<n>from meee!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're trembling like a leaf... There's<n>no need to
push yourself so hard if<n>you're this scared. It's
really difficult<n>to overcome your fear all at once.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But look! You managed to walk up to<n>it so bravely,
and that's massive<n>progress! You can leave the
rest to<n>me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second, Pearl! I'm the one on<n>cleaning duty
today!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate Umamusume would never<n>shrink from a
task assigned<n>specifically to her... I must do it
myself!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, King! All right, you go ahead. I'll<n>be your backup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But before we tackle the challenge<n>again, how
about taking a breather to<n>muster some strength for
the task?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, while King Halo is taking a<n>break, Seeking
the Pearl dashes off<n>around the academy.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're good with synthesizers,<n>right? I
sometimes hear you playing in<n>the plaza. You've
got such a powerful<n>sound. Think you could help
me out a<n>little?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I need you to lend me your<n>soul-stirring voice! And
you over<n>there! I need you too! Let that
unforgettable, angelic voice of yours<n>ring out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl goes around the<n>school gathering
a team of students.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time we return to where King<n>Halo is waiting,
she's got a sizable<n>entourage with her!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Um, what's going on? Everyone's<n>brought
instruments... Are they part of<n>the school band or
something?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I've assembled a resplendent<n>cheering squad
befitting of your<n>standards. This little number is
dedicated to our wonderful King! A<n>one, a two—a
one, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Whatcha gonna doooo? Oh, yeeeah,<n>yeeeah! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bouncy synth and energetic<n>chorus that fills the
air make it feel as<n>though we're right in the middle
of a<n>huge disco!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
King of kings! Oh, yeeeah, yeeeah!<n>Forever
reaching for the top, born to<n>rule! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone knows that you have it! ♪<n>Your cool pride
echoes around the<n>wooorld!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Running away in fear doesn't suit<n>you! ♪ Fire up
your engines and step<n>onto the road!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
King of kings! Oh, yeeeah, yeeeah!<n>You are the
first-class, first-rate Kiiing!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...You had me completely entranced!<n>That was
first-rate cheering, indeed!<n>Thank you all so much.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The rest is up to you. You have to<n>decide now
whether to show your<n>back and retreat, or move
forward<n>and fight.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. After how you've just set the<n>stage, to back
down now would be to<n>sully my name!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...It's just a spiderweb, after all!<n>YAAAH!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Did I get it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pearl! I... I did it! I defeated the<n>spiderweb!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Your unswaying<n>courage truly
touched my heart! That<n>was amazing, King! You
were<n>absolutely fantastic!
choice_data_list:
Keep it up and you'll conquer your fear of bugs
altogether.
That was one powerful broom swing!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Let's get started with<n>our next round
of special training! I'll<n>act like a bug, and you try
and swat<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Scuttle, scuttle, scuttle!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: S-stooop! Your acting is too realistic,<n>Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl begins a new kind<n>of special
training to help King Halo<n>conquer her fears!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! This is exactly what we trained<n>for! If we
keep going, you'll soon be<n>able to catch real
spiders with your<n>bare hands!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: W-with my bare hands?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you'll manage it in time. You're<n>the proud
and mighty King, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a little help from Seeking the<n>Pearl, King Halo is
able to finish all of<n>her cleaning duties!
